summary: Tested new 'Barkoddan Fiyat Gör' feature end-to-end: backend POST /api/data/barcode-price + frontend /fiyat-gor screen + entry buttons. 6/6 backend pytest tests PASS. Frontend web preview flow (login → /fiyat-gor → manual barcode search) works perfectly: known barcode 9990000000012 returns DENEME product (STK-00000009), stock -486, price list Parekende ₺467,50 (KDV Dahil); unknown barcode shows 'Ürün bulunamadı' card.
